segments.normalizedSource: ```javascript if (window.WebKitPlaybackTargetAvailabilityEvent) { video.addEventListener('webkitplaybacktargetavailabilitychanged', function(event) { switch (event.availability) { case "available": airPlayButton.hidden = false; airPlayButton.disabled = false; break; case "not-available": airPlayButton.hidden = true; airPlayButton.disabled = true; break; } }); } ```
segments.contextBefore: If the button is not visible, controls are hidden, or the user is in fullscreen mode, stop listening.
